$description: OGE UI design tokens in the Design Tokens Community Group format (2025.10). Generated from packages/grid/src/lib/styles/_tokens.scss and themes/*.css by `nx run docs-tools:llms` — do not edit. Each token maps to the CSS custom property in $extensions["com.ogeui"].cssVariable; computed tints carry their CSS expression in $extensions["com.ogeui"].css. https://www.ogeui.com/getting-started/tokens

muted-color.$description: ≥ 4.5:1 on every light surface (bg, header, group, hover, selected)

success.$description: severity palette (buttons, inputs, toasts, badges); each fill carries white text and each colour reads as text on white at >= 4.5:1

severity-contrast.$description: text color on contained severity/accent fills

shadow-btn.$description: elevation of contained buttons (dark theme overrides with black-based)

shadow-card.$description: resting elevation of raised cards — lighter than --oge-shadow-popup

skeleton-color.$description: loading placeholders (skeleton bones, grid skeleton rows)

switch-thumb.$description: switch knob — stays light on both themes, like the platform controls

scrollbar-thumb.$description: scrollbars of every scroll area the suite draws (grid body, lists, calendars, pivot); visible against the surface on a mouse desktop

z-window.$description: non-modal floating windows: below anchored popups (a select opened in a window shows above it) and modals; each window adds its stacking layer

z-fab.$description: floating action buttons: below windows, popups and modals, above content

z-app-bar.$description: fixed / sticky app bars: below FABs, so a FAB never hides under a bottom bar

z-modal.$description: modal layer (above anchored popups; legacy grid dialogs sit at 1090/1100)

z-drawer.$description: drawer panel; shares the modal layer, ordering comes from the shared stack

z-toast.$description: toast regions (above modals — failure toasts must show over open dialogs)

tooltip-bg.$description: tooltip bubble (inverted surface; dark theme overrides)

scheduler-chip-fg.$description: scheduler surfaces (commercial package hooks into the same theme files)

gantt-scale-head.$description: height of the timeline scale header (gantt chart pane)

accent-soft.$description: soft accent tints: follow --oge-accent wherever it is set with them

input-filled-bg.$description: filled-field surface; dark theme overrides with a surface-independent tint

chart-track.$description: gauges, bullets, heatmap / map empties, neutral Sankey links (W8c)
